The ordering and breakdown look sensible. I noticed one gap: the plan promised a browser-based check for every story, but the task list does not include one for the notes/edit/delete story or the import/export story.

Please add checks that cover:

- Adding and displaying a formatted note, editing all bookmark fields, finding the note through search, and confirming permanent deletion.
- Exporting through the interface and importing through the interface, confirming titles, tags, and original dates are preserved and duplicates are skipped.

The note-search check can run after search has been implemented. With those tasks added, I approve the breakdown and you may begin implementation, pausing after the US1/US2 working version as proposed.
